testcase.name: Scenario: Hide and restore a panel on the side-docked ribbon: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-visibility-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-visibility/ribbon-panel-visibility.feature:63:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Hide and restore a panel on the side-docked ribbon ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/blank-metric-part.opd` is open and active ✔ And the 3D Model ribbon is docked on the left ✔ And the Modify group is visible ✔ When the user opens the direct panel selector ✔ Then Modify is checked ✔ When the user selects Modify in the panel selector ✔ Then the Modify group disappears from the side-docked ribbon ✔ And the remaining ribbon groups reflow vertically ✔ And the panel selector remains open with Modify unchecked ✔ When the user selects Modify in the panel selector ✔ Then the Modify group returns to the side-docked ribbon ✔ And the panel selector remains open with Modify checked
